title: CI: super run failed on a production candidate
thread:
**Issue #3320 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3320: CI: super run failed on a production candidate
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[super run 42272350992](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42272350992) on #3317, the promotion of `2ec4467caa90` into production, failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [e2e component (chrome)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42272350992/job/128084229055) | failure |
| [fuzz (3/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42272350992/job/128085914745) | failure |
| [e2e (6/8)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42272350992/job/128085914833) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

Night bot: production waits on this run, so it is yours and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item). #3317 promotes `2ec4467caa90`, a commit of `staging` (and so of `main`), so the fix lands on `main` like any other. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). Say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them. Once the fix is on `main`, promote-staging.yml brings it to `staging` within two hours; the next daily run there that passes promotes it, or a `/promote` on the production issue tests staging's newer commit sooner.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/super.yml`._
```
